description: The client-side composition of one action. Every state narrows the engine's enumerated move list; none of them decides legality.

idle.description: No action in progress. The action bar shows one button per move kind, disabled where the enumeration offers nothing of that kind.

build.description: Map-first build: a slot, then a card, then — only if the card is ambiguous — an industry.

location.description: Every slot carrying at least one enumerated build is highlighted. Clicking anything else does nothing.

card.description: The card picker offers the union of eligibleCards across the builds at this slot.

PICK_CARD.guard: exactly one industry is legal for this card at this slot
PICK_CARD.description: The common case. A slot that allows one industry, or a location card that names one, resolves without a third question.

industry.description: Reached only by a card that authorises more than one industry at this slot — a dual Cotton/Manufacturer card, or a wild.

network.description: Map-first link building. In the canal era this is always link then card; the rail era adds the two-road question.

link.description: Every edge appearing in any enumerated network move is highlighted.

PICK_EDGE.guard: a legal two-edge rail move includes this edge
PICK_EDGE.description: The enumerator has already gated this on two links left, fifteen pounds and a reachable barrel — the flow only asks the question when the answer can be yes.

choose.description: One road or two. The only question in the whole interface that the map cannot ask for itself.

link2.description: Re-highlights only the edges that form a legal pair with the first — derived from the two-edge moves that contain it, never recomputed.

card.description: eligibleCards for the single- or double-link move now selected.

simple.description: Loan, scout and pass. No map target — the only input is which card or cards to discard.

card.description: Scout takes three cards, the others take one. The picker is skipped entirely when only one distinct card face is eligible.

dispatching.description: Exactly one enumerated move is selected. The planner is asked what it would consume before anything is sent.

NEEDS_SOURCE.description: Raised only when at least one decision has more than one candidate. Forced and empty decisions never produce a prompt.

sourcing.description: Walking the prompt queue one decision at a time — which coal, which iron, which barrel, which merchant.

PICK_CANDIDATE.guard: the prompt queue is now empty
